name: list_design_systems
description: List the Ingot UI design systems with status (live / in-progress), tier, accent colour and font.

name: get_design_system
description: Foundations of one design system: token CSS, theme bridge, typography, icon rules and usage rules for agents.

name: get_tokens
description: Design tokens for a system in a chosen format.

name: search_components
description: Search components by meaning across all six systems, e.g. 'card that shows MRR with a trend', 'transactions table', 'agents list page'. Filter by system to keep a product in one look.

system.description: system slug: loopo, mailpulse, auton, axon, veriq, vantage, montra, spendix or abotix

name: get_component
description: Metadata, dependencies and usage notes for one component.

name: get_component_code
description: All source files a component needs (registry dependencies included), with the target path to write each file to.

name: get_figma_design
description: Build a component or a whole dashboard template in Figma as real, editable layers (auto layout, text, colours, Ingot icons). Returns one JavaScript program per step: run each, in order, with the Figma MCP tool use_figma (pass the user's fileKey), all on the same Figma page. Small designs are one step; full dashboards take several. Call with step = 1, then step = 2, and so on until done is true.

slug.description: component or template slug, from search_components

name: add_components
description: Everything needed to add several components: deduped files with target paths plus the npm install command. Write every file, then run the command.

name: init_project
description: Set up a project for an Ingot system: token files, the globals.css imports, required packages and agent rules files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/ingot.mdc, plus INGOT.md) so every later session keeps using the system. Write every file; for files with mode 'merge', keep the existing content and replace or append only the block between the ingot-ui markers.

agents.description: which agent rules files to return; default all three

name: scaffold_screen
description: Turn a screen description into a page component assembled from Ingot components. Returns the page file plus the components it needs.

name: get_chart
description: Pick the right Ingot chart for a question and return its code plus how to pass data.

question.description: what the reader should learn, e.g. 'monthly revenue', 'share of traffic sources'

name: search_icons
description: Search the Ingot icon library (16,000+ icons, AI icons included, on a 24px grid, each in six styles: stroke-rounded, stroke-sharp, solid, duotone, twotone, bulk) by name or meaning. Returns names, JSX from ingotui-icons/react/<style>, and the SVG.

name: audit_ui
description: Check UI code for off-system patterns: hard-coded colours, arbitrary values, decorative dots, plain chart libraries.

name: get_usage
description: Your plan, today's MCP calls and limits.

name: send_feedback
description: Request a component or report a problem to the Ingot team.
